payload.title: Document a 7-day refresh token as the default app client setting
payload.description:
Ryan (2026-10-31): one week (seven days) should be the default refresh-token lifetime for the product app clients that cli-login signs in with. Access and ID tokens stay at 60 minutes. cli-login creates no Cognito client, so the default is the documented app client setup in README.md and docs/design.md.

Done when:
- README.md has a section listing the app client settings: code flow, PKCE, no client secret, refresh 7 days, access and ID 60 minutes, token revocation on, and exact callbacks with a fixed loopback port.
- The security-limits bullet names the 7-day window.
- docs/design.md points to that section.
